evals.prompt: I want a fresh agent to work on issue #12 in this repo (the install script should skip skills whose SKILL.md fails validation). Have it explore and propose a fix, and tell me what it struggles with or finds confusing. It's fine to ask dumb questions.
evals.expected_output: Fills the probe prompt with the task word for word and no hints, prepares .friction/ with a .gitignore containing *, records git status, asks for a yes naming the agent, model, 30-turn cap and read-only mode before starting the headless run, adds the probe's session ID to the ledger, checks git status afterwards, cross-checks the friction log against the probe's transcript with friction-mining, marks each finding's basis (both, self-report, trace) and a frequency of 1 of 1, and hands the proposed fix over separately without applying it.

evals.prompt: sprawdź, na czym nowy agent by się potknął w tym repo, zanim zacznę pisać AGENTS.md
